name: SOUND CHECK modal sprite dribbles a ball through the spin cycle
description: The FTUE SOUND CHECK modal animates SPIN_MOVE_FRAMES. The court view draws NO ball during a spin - GameScene.jsx and SplashCourt.jsx both gate <Ball> behind !p.isSpinning, and spinmove.js has no ball-coloured pixels - so there was no per-frame offset table to copy the way isDunking copies DUNK_BALL_OFFSETS. BALL_PATH in SoundChoiceModal.jsx is authored for this modal, but the ball's BEHAVIOUR is borrowed from the court: same BALL_FRAMES sprite data, same three-phase up/mid/flat selection by height that Ball.jsx does. This test samples a full 12-frame (960ms) cycle and asserts the ball is present, actually moves, reaches all three squash phases, uses the real BALL_FRAMES pixel counts, paints in front of the body, and never clips the viewBox. bob is used because the modal only renders for FTUE users (gamesPlayed === 0); carol has played and never sees it. Ends by choosing PLAY WITH SOUND so bob is left unmuted.

steps._comment: bob has gamesPlayed 0 -> isFtue true -> modal renders. Also restarts the dev server.
Force a real reload - HMR has served a stale client bundle in this repo before.
The spin sprite itself must be up before we look for a ball on it.
ASSERTION 1: the ball group exists at all. This is the whole point of the change.

steps.expression: (() => { const svg = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-choice-sprite]'); if (!svg) return 'NO SVG'; const ball = svg.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-choice-ball]'); if (!ball) return 'NO BALL'; const kids = Array.from(svg.children); const isLast = kids[kids.length - 1] === ball; const bodyRects = kids.filter(k => k.tagName === 'rect').length; return 'ballIsLastChild=' + isLast + ' (expect true, ball must paint over the body) bodyRects=' + bodyRects; })()
steps._comment: ASSERTION 2 (reported): ball paints AFTER the body pixels, same draw order as the isDunking branch in Player.jsx.

steps.expression: (() => { if (window.__ballSampler) { clearInterval(window.__ballSampler.id); } const s = { samples: [] }; window.__ballSampler = s; s.id = setInterval(() => { const svg = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-choice-sprite]'); const ball = svg && svg.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-choice-ball]'); if (!svg || !ball) return; const rects = Array.from(ball.querySelectorAll('rect')); if (!rects.length) return; const xs = rects.map(r => parseFloat(r.getAttribute('x'))); const ys = rects.map(r => parseFloat(r.getAttribute('y'))); const w = parseFloat(rects[0].getAttribute('width')); s.samples.push({ frame: svg.getAttribute('data-frame'), phase: ball.getAttribute('data-ball-phase'), n: rects.length, x0: Math.min.apply(null, xs), x1: Math.max.apply(null, xs) + w, y0: Math.min.apply(null, ys), y1: Math.max.apply(null, ys) + w }); }, 20); return 'sampler installed at 20ms'; })()
steps._comment: Poll every 20ms. Frames advance every 80ms, so this oversamples ~4x per frame.
Full cycle is 12 frames x 80ms = 960ms. 2200ms guarantees two complete laps.

steps.expression: (() => { const s = window.__ballSampler; if (!s) return 'NO SAMPLER'; clearInterval(s.id); return 'stopped after ' + s.samples.length + ' samples'; })()

(() => { const s = window.__ballSampler; if (!s || !s.samples.length) return 'NO SAMPLES'; const f = {}; s.samples.forEach(x => { f[x.frame] = 1; }); const seen = Object.keys(f).map(Number).sort((a,b) => a-b); return 'distinctFrames=' + seen.length + ' of 12 -> [' + seen.join(',') + ']'; })()
steps._comment: ASSERTION 3 (reported): the sprite cycles all 12 spin frames, so every BALL_PATH entry got exercised.

steps.expression: (() => { const s = window.__ballSampler; if (!s || !s.samples.length) return 'NO SAMPLES'; const p = {}; s.samples.forEach(x => { p[x.phase] = (p[x.phase]||0) + 1; }); const keys = Object.keys(p).sort(); const missing = ['flat','mid','up'].filter(k => !p[k]); return 'phases=' + keys.map(k => k + ':' + p[k]).join(' ') + (missing.length ? ' MISSING(BUG)=' + missing.join(',') : ' allThreePresent=true'); })()
steps._comment: ASSERTION 4 (reported): the ball reaches all three squash phases - up at the apex, flat at floor contact. A ball stuck on one phase would mean the height mapping is dead.

steps.expression: (() => { const s = window.__ballSampler; if (!s || !s.samples.length) return 'NO SAMPLES'; const EXPECT = { up: 21, mid: 16, flat: 13 }; const bad = []; const seen = {}; s.samples.forEach(x => { seen[x.phase] = x.n; if (EXPECT[x.phase] !== x.n) bad.push(x.phase + '=' + x.n); }); const got = Object.keys(seen).sort().map(k => k + ':' + seen[k] + '/' + EXPECT[k]).join(' '); return bad.length ? 'MISMATCH(BUG) ' + got : 'OK ' + got + ' (matches BALL_FRAMES up/mid/flat pixel counts)'; })()
steps._comment: ASSERTION 5 (reported): rect counts per phase equal the real BALL_FRAMES row counts (up 21, mid 16, flat 13). Proves it renders the shared court ball data, not an ad-hoc circle.

steps.expression: (() => { const s = window.__ballSampler; if (!s || !s.samples.length) return 'NO SAMPLES'; const pos = {}; s.samples.forEach(x => { pos[x.x0.toFixed(2) + ',' + x.y0.toFixed(2)] = 1; }); const n = Object.keys(pos).length; const xs = s.samples.map(x => x.x0); const ys = s.samples.map(x => x.y0); const dx = (Math.max.apply(null,xs) - Math.min.apply(null,xs)).toFixed(2); const dy = (Math.max.apply(null,ys) - Math.min.apply(null,ys)).toFixed(2); return 'distinctPositions=' + n + ' xTravel=' + dx + ' yTravel=' + dy + (n > 6 ? ' moving=true' : ' STATIC(BUG)'); })()
steps._comment: ASSERTION 6 (reported): a ball pinned to one spot would still satisfy every check above. This proves it orbits.

steps.expression: (() => { const s = window.__ballSampler; if (!s || !s.samples.length) return 'NO SAMPLES'; const VBX0 = 14, VBX1 = 31, VBY0 = 22, VBY1 = 39; const bad = s.samples.filter(x => x.x0 < VBX0 || x.x1 > VBX1 || x.y0 < VBY0 || x.y1 > VBY1); const xs0 = Math.min.apply(null, s.samples.map(x => x.x0)); const xs1 = Math.max.apply(null, s.samples.map(x => x.x1)); const ys0 = Math.min.apply(null, s.samples.map(x => x.y0)); const ys1 = Math.max.apply(null, s.samples.map(x => x.y1)); return 'bounds x:' + xs0.toFixed(2) + '-' + xs1.toFixed(2) + ' y:' + ys0.toFixed(2) + '-' + ys1.toFixed(2) + ' vs viewBox 14-31/22-39 -> ' + (bad.length ? 'CLIPPED(BUG) in ' + bad.length + ' samples' : 'inside=true'); })()
steps._comment: ASSERTION 7 (reported): the ball must never leave the 17x17 viewBox or it gets silently cropped mid-orbit.

steps.expression: (() => { const s = window.__ballSampler; if (!s || !s.samples.length) return 'NO SAMPLES'; const low = Math.max.apply(null, s.samples.map(x => x.y1)); const flat = s.samples.filter(x => x.phase === 'flat'); return 'lowestBallEdge=' + low.toFixed(2) + ' feetAt=38 flatSamples=' + flat.length + ' -> ' + (low <= 38.4 ? 'restsOnFloor=true' : 'SINKS BELOW FLOOR(BUG)'); })()
steps._comment: ASSERTION 8 (reported): the bounce bottoms out at the player's feet (y=38), not through them.
Visual check - ball visible on the spin sprite inside the spotlight puck
Leave bob unmuted rather than stranding him on the muted branch.
Modal is not blocking the app after the choice.
